paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Avdimi: Jerusalem Sheloshah she-Akhelu, mishnah 1. Bar Avduma: Jerusalem Dinei Mamonot, halakhah 11. Avduma: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 2. He asked Rav Yitzhak ben Elazar and R' Mana: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of R' Eliezer de-Milah. His mother died eight days before the festival; he asked R' Mana: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Mo'ed Katan. Rav Shashna was his son.
